pundit.name: Landon Donovan
pundit.take: **Look, I get why people say Gunner's just lucky because no one ever calls Morocco a Tier 2 powerhouse.** Norway's recent form might suggest they're punching above their weight, but when they're up against England, Devin—bless his heart, drafting Haiti in the fourth round without a bit of irony—might realize his luck ran out. "The Backpass Assassin" (Gayden) is sitting fourth in this pool, and while some might call that a concerning position for someone with England, Japan, and Ivory Coast in his arsenal, I think it's a masterclass in underachievement. Devin did well yesterday with Spain, but when you're hoping for Norway to break down England's defense, it's sort of like trying to cut steak with a plastic fork—valiant but ultimately messy. My prediction? England takes this one comfortably, and Gayden moves an inch up the standings, but not enough for any real bragging rights.
